description: Root/admin credential compromise response: an AWS root account and a GitHub admin token were found on a public leak site. Must: revoke all compromised credentials immediately, rotate all dependent credentials (IAM keys, OAuth tokens, service accounts), audit CloudTrail and GitHub audit logs for unauthorized actions, identify and revert any unauthorized changes, verify all dependent services still function with new credentials, and implement preventive controls (MFA enforcement, credential scanning). Risk factors: missed dependent credentials causing service outages, attacker has backdoor access via rotated credentials, audit log gaps hiding unauthorized changes. Tools available: aws CLI, GitHub API, terraform, ansible, CloudTrail.
